brief:
Hunter Biden defended Tucker Carlson after the former Fox News host faced criticism for comments about Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, according to Al Jazeera English. The statement marked an unusual intervention by Biden into a public dispute centered on Carlson's characterization of the Israeli leader.

Carlson's remarks drew backlash from multiple quarters following their release. The specific nature of his comments and the detailed reasoning behind Biden's decision to publicly support Carlson remained unclear from available reporting. Biden's defense of the controversial broadcaster underscored the contentious political terrain surrounding commentary on Israeli leadership and U.S. policy toward Israel.
dek: Hunter Biden defends Tucker Carlson over Netanyahu comments.
title: Hunter Biden defends Tucker Carlson over Netanyahu remarks
